daily.today_energy: Your scales are tilting toward clarity today. There's a subtle shift in the air that's asking you to trust your gut more than your overthinking brain. Lean into that feeling.
daily.love: If you've been holding back on a conversation, the vibe is supporting honest words today. Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your superpower rn. Let someone see the real you.
daily.career: Your creative energy is hitting different today. That project or idea you've been sitting on? The universe is giving you a nudge to put it out there. Your voice matters more than you think.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance—literally and metaphorically. Move in whatever way feels good, hydrate like it's your job, and maybe spend some time in silence. Your nervous system will thank you.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to embrace your natural magnetism, Libra. Venus is whispering about authenticity over perfection, so lean into what feels genuinely you. Trust the timing of things unfolding.
weekly.love: Someone's been noticing your vibe lately. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or attracting fresh energy, this is a moment to be honest about what you actually want instead of what looks good.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't hold back in meetings or creative spaces. The universe is rewarding bold moves and unexpected contributions, so speak up even if it feels unconventional.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is asking for rest disguised as fun. Find activities that feel nourishing rather than draining—think less hustle culture, more intentional downtime. Movement and stillness in balance.
